Darwix Commercial Lending Handbook - 2026
Section 1: General Business Loan Eligibility Thresholds
This policy outlines the official underwriting thresholds for all commercial credit facilities.
1. Minimum Operating History: The borrowing business must have at least 6 months of verifiable operating history for
short-term working capital loans, and a minimum of 12 to 24 months for prime commercial term loans.
2. Minimum Gross Revenue: Businesses must demonstrate minimum average monthly gross revenues of ,000 (,000
annualized), verified via 3 to 6 months of official business checking bank statements.
3. Geographic Eligibility: The borrower entity must be registered and actively operating within any of the 50 United
States or the District of Columbia. Foreign entities are strictly ineligible.
